# Pixel Task List

An offline, pixel-style task list built with only HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server, build step, or network connection is required.

## Features

- Add tasks by typing and pressing Enter or clicking **Add**.
- Blank or whitespace-only input is ignored.
- Each task gets a unique increasing numeric ID.
- Checkboxes toggle completion; completed tasks are struck through.
- Delete buttons remove tasks.
- Live counts: **Total** and **Remaining** (incomplete) update automatically.
- All state is kept in memory only — refreshing the page resets everything.
- Fully keyboard accessible with visible focus states.
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide.

## Required IDs

| Element | ID |
|---|---|
| Text input | `todo-input` |
| Add button | `todo-add` |
| Total count | `todo-total` |
| Remaining count | `remaining` |
| Task text (nth task) | `todo-text-{id}` |
| Task checkbox (nth task) | `todo-check-{id}` |
| Task delete button (nth task) | `todo-delete-{id}` |

## Constraints

- No external assets, imports, packages, network requests, iframes, or server code.
- Uses `addEventListener` only — no inline event handlers.
- Source files: `index.html`, `styles.css`, `app.js`, `README.md`.
- Under 240 total source lines.
